quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.
Watch for people crossing the road.
Take a detour to avoid unsafe road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid unsafe road conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the traffic pattern or route is changing because of road work ahead. Follow the detour signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you need to reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you reach this intersection and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill grade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a hill is ahead.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Start to slow down your vehicle.
Not slow down because traffic will back up.
Slow down only if you want to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start to slow down your vehicle.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin reducing your speed. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers when they can turn left. Wait for the left turn signal to light up before turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the highway will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming and you should adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign is posted near intersections to remind drivers not to block traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you that a new lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic on the green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic on the green light.
questions.explanation: This sign works with traffic signals. It tells left-turning drivers they do not have the right of way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter this road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a narrow bridge is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions ahead. This sign tells you the shoulder is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign tells you that from this lane, you can either turn right or continue straight through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The safe speed for a residential area.
The safe speed for leaving an expressway.
The safe speed for entering an expressway.
The safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for leaving an expressway.
questions.explanation: This speed sign tells you the safe speed to use when exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
You can proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong direction and could have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully and find the correct route.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign tells you a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you not to enter. It is posted at the end of one-way streets. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means traffic from both directions can use the center lane only to turn left. Do not use it as a regular driving lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. This sign alerts you that a traffic light is coming. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Let other cars and pedestrians go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: From top to bottom, traffic lights are ordered as:
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green on the bottom for vertical lights. Red is always on the left and green on the right for horizontal lights.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to road hazards. This sign warns of a winding road ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to road hazards. This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other cars and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic from the left is merging into your lane.
The right lane ends. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. You must move to the left lane.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that overhead clearance is low in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at low speed and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted in parking lots. It marks reserved parking spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It alerts you to an upcoming intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It tells you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely. Check for pedestrians and traffic in the intersection. Wait until it is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You may complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will redirect your route. Be ready to follow a different path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that all traffic moves only in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road crossing ahead will create an intersection.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right has one-way traffic only.
Construction ahead requires a right turn detour.
The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road changes direction at a sharp angle. You should slow down as if you were making a turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. This sign indicates either a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow, with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that people may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, do not brake or turn suddenly, and keep more distance between your car and the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic moves on this street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on a bridge over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a barrier or median between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is one-way traffic only.
Only one car can use the bridge at a time.
The bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the bridge ahead is narrow. You may not have room to meet or pass a truck. Be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is not allowed here at any time. You must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a low railroad crossing. The tracks cross at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What should you do at a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection go first before you enter.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road conditions ahead.
It shows directions to nearby cities.
It tells you about traffic laws.
It warns you about road construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on yellow backgrounds. They warn drivers about conditions on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows limited parking. You can park there for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop.

questions.question: What is this sign warning you about?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you lanes are moving. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means large trucks are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A traffic light ahead is showing red.
A traffic light ahead is broken.
A traffic light ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you to follow a detour because the normal road is blocked by construction work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that bicycles cross this area. Drive carefully because bikes may cross or ride beside the road here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you to be careful because the road may be wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that cars may enter from a side road ahead. Be alert for traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the minimum legal speed. You must not drive slower than the speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way traffic. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers to stay alert. There may be a hazard ahead, and you should be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: You may not exit the freeway.
You may continue through or exit the freeway from your current lane.
You may stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway. You can change lanes to continue through, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room if you can. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let the merging traffic in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let the traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed shown.
The maximum legal speed is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can legally drive. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than this limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign alerts drivers to watch for buggies ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs indicate railroad crossings. This sign tells drivers that a railroad crossing is coming and they should watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What do these signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. These object markers warn drivers about hazardous objects or areas that should be avoided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in construction zones. This sign tells drivers that a flagger ahead will give directions that must be followed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you about an upcoming traffic signal. Get ready to stop at a red light, slow down at a yellow light, or watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the highest legal speed for that road when conditions are good. When weather or road conditions are bad, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about workers on or near the road. Drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead has loose gravel. Drive slowly and carefully because your tires will not grip the road as well.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that farm machinery may be in the area. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you there is a stop sign coming up. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. Follow any directions given by a crossing guard.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, the driver is signaling that they will stop. If you see this, be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond-shaped warning sign tells you that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead. Be prepared to merge or adjust your driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you the road will soon become a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a playground is near and to watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet, making it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A regulation sign with a red circle and red slash means the action is prohibited. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a curve ahead in the direction of the arrow. The sign recommends driving at 35 mph or slower around this curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
